mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_nm AS roleNm, NULL::varchar AS roleDc, CASE WHEN r.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS roleLevel, 'Y' AS tenantScoped, #{tenantCode} AS tenantCode, r.use_at AS useAt, COALESCE(r.is_system_role, 'N') AS systemRoleYn, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.is_system_role, 'N') = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS systemRole, r.created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, r.updated_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_role r WHERE r.role_id = #{value} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_role ( tenant_id, role_code, role_nm, use_at, is_system_role, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{roleCode}, #{roleNm}, #{useAt}, COALESCE(#{systemRoleYn}, 'N'), now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_role SET role_nm = #{roleNm}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
UPDATE tb_role SET use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id FROM tb_menu m WHERE m.menu_code = #{value} LIMIT 1
SELECT r.role_id FROM tb_role r INNER JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} ORDER BY r.role_id LIMIT 1
SELECT m.menu_code FROM tb_menu m WHERE m.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY m.menu_order, m.menu_id, m.menu_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_permission ( tenant_id, permission_code, permission_nm, use_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{permissionCode}, #{permissionNm}, 'Y', now() ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, permission_code) DO UPDATE SET permission_nm = EXCLUDED.permission_nm, use_at = 'Y'
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE mapped_menu AS ( SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_menu_id, MAX(CASE WHEN p.permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_write FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_permission rmp ON m.menu_id = rmp.menu_id INNER JOIN tb_permission p ON rmp.permission_id = p.permission_id INNER JOIN tb_login_account_role lar ON lar.role_id = rmp.role_id INNER JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = lar.login_id INNER JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lar.role_id WHERE m.use_at = 'Y' AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND la.login_code = #{loginId} AND la.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(r.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.parent_menu_id ), menu_tree AS ( SELECT mm.menu_id, mm.parent_menu_id, mm.has_write FROM mapped_menu mm UNION SELECT parent.menu_id, parent.parent_menu_id, 0 AS has_write FROM tb_menu parent INNER JOIN menu_tree mt ON mt.parent_menu_id = parent.menu_id WHERE parent.use_at = 'Y' ) SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId, m.menu_code AS menuCode, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, COALESCE(m.menu_dc, '') AS menuDc, m.parent_menu_id AS parentMenuId, m.menu_order AS menuOrdr, m.menu_url AS menuUrl, COALESCE(m.icon_nm, 'Menu') AS iconNm, m.use_at AS useAt, CASE WHEN MAX(mt.has_write) = 1 THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END AS permissionLevel, 1 AS accessible FROM menu_tree mt INNER JOIN tb_menu m ON m.menu_id = mt.menu_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu p ON m.parent_menu_id = p.menu_id WHERE m.use_at = 'Y' GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_nm, m.menu_dc, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.icon_nm, m.use_at, p.menu_order, p.menu_id ORDER BY COALESCE(p.menu_order, m.menu_order), COALESCE(p.menu_id, m.menu_id), m.parent_menu_id NULLS FIRST, m.menu_order, m.menu_id
